pages.title: An Arrow with a Job
pages.text: Replace a distant approach with a suitable lighting or extinguishing projectile.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Torch/Lantern Arrow places light at a suitable impact surface. Extinguishing Arrow puts out fire and converts affected lava to obsidian. Atlantean Arrow separately avoids ordinary underwater slowdown.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Light arrows place light, extinguishing changes fire/lava, Atlantean retains underwater motion.
